text:
At 01:58 the spare room light came on. No motion was recorded in the room, before or after, which the house did not mention.

At 02:47 the hallway sensor detected movement. Alex's and Sam's phones were at home, and no other motion had been recorded for over an hour.

At 03:01 the spare room thermometer read 13.0 degrees. Ten minutes earlier it had read 19.2. Radiators, I am told, do not do that.

At 03:12 the back door opened. It closed again some fifty seconds later. No motion had been recorded anywhere in the ten minutes before it, and none was recorded after, so the door must have opened and closed itself, politely, like a guest who knows the house.

The sensors say nothing more. They never do. Whatever it was, it was tidy.
